guides.title: 製程統計管制系統：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Statistical process-control systems: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「規格與控制：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：控制線描述製程行為，規格線描述需求。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Specifications and control: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Control limits describe behavior; specifications describe requirements. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜規格與控制：建立模型：控制線描述製程行為，規格線描述需求；穩定製程仍可能不符客戶規格。
觀察站 2｜屬性資料：建立模型：缺陷數與不合格單位数不是同一分布；樣本數改變會影響比例圖控制限。
觀察站 3｜變更管理：故障判讀與驗證：重設控制線不能取代原因改善；新舊版本比較需防止挑選有利期間。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Specifications and control: construct and analyze: Control limits describe behavior; specifications describe requirements; Stable processes can still miss specifications.
Observation station 2 | Attribute data: construct and analyze: Defect counts and defective-unit counts differ; Sample size changes proportion-chart limits.
Observation station 3 | Change management: diagnose and verify: Resetting limits does not replace cause correction; Version comparisons must avoid cherry-picked periods.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「屬性資料：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「變更管理：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Attribute data: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Change management: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把上下規格限直接當控制限」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「一片多缺陷就算多片不合格」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Using specification limits as control limits", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Counting several defects as several defective wafers", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.overview: 從「製程統計管制系統」延伸比較先進製程控制與虛擬量測、晶圓缺陷分類與良率分析：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Statistical process-control systems by comparing Advanced process control and virtual metrology and Wafer defect classification and yield analysis: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: SPC 與 APC／虛擬量測都以時間序列監控製程，漂移、延遲與資料版本會影響決策。
related.transferEn: SPC and APC/virtual metrology both use process time series, with drift, delay and data versions affecting decisions.
related.difference: SPC 主要判斷統計穩定與調查；APC 會調整輸入，虛擬量測則預測未量值。預測不能自動當成實測閉環依據。
related.differenceEn: SPC primarily assesses stability and investigation; APC changes inputs, while virtual metrology predicts unmeasured values. Predictions are not automatically physical measurements.
practice: 分開監控警報、預測及控制動作三條流程。
用時間切分驗證模型，避免未來資料洩漏。
訂定漂移時恢復實體量測與人工審查的門檻。
practiceEn: Separate monitoring alarms, predictions and control actions.
Validate with temporal splits to avoid future-data leakage.
Define drift thresholds for physical metrology and human review.
related.title: 先進製程控制與虛擬量測
related.titleEn: Advanced process control and virtual metrology

related.whyEn: SPC and APC/virtual metrology both use process time series, with drift, delay and data versions affecting decisions.

related.transfer: 缺陷與良率資料可成為統計監控輸入，但必須保持檢出條件、分母及批次分組一致。
related.transferEn: Defect and yield data can feed statistical monitoring if detection conditions, denominators and subgrouping remain consistent.
related.difference: 缺陷分類關注型態及危害；SPC 關注隨時間的穩定性。控制圖訊號提示需調查，不直接指定物理根因。
related.differenceEn: Defect classification concerns morphology and criticality; SPC concerns temporal stability. A chart signal calls for investigation rather than identifying a unique physical cause.
practice: 把缺陷事件換算成定義清楚的單位率。
按腔室與時間建立合理子群。
將失控點回連檢查條件與設備履歷。
practiceEn: Convert detections into rates with explicit denominators.
Form rational subgroups by chamber and time.
Link signals back to inspection conditions and equipment history.

courses.summary: 本課以「NIST 量測研究參考園區」作為公開研究、量測或產業歷史的代表地點。從規格與控制、Xbar 與 R到變更管理：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。 技術由多個地區、企業與研究團隊共同發展；地圖不是唯一發明地，也不是未公開生產設施定位。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses NIST metrology-research reference campus as a public research, metrology or industrial-history reference. From Specifications and control and Xbar and range to Change management: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages. Multiple regions and institutions develop these technologies; the map is neither an exclusive invention claim nor undisclosed production coordinates.
